title: rs3dev project configuration
description: Optional rs3dev.json in a plugin folder. Command line flags override these values. The file is a development artefact: sync, watch and package leave it out.

ignore.description: Finding codes to drop from preflight and validate output, for example ["low-comment-ratio"]. Reviewed exceptions only; the code still ships to moderators.

maxLineLength.description: Lines longer than this count towards the minification heuristic (default 200).

minCommentRatio.description: Comment lines divided by code lines below which a file over 40 lines gets low-comment-ratio (default 0.05).

root.description: dev_plugins folder, same meaning as --root; must exist and look like dev_plugins.

prune.description: Delete files in the destination that the source no longer has (default true).

outDir.description: Folder for the zip, relative to the plugin folder when not absolute (default dist/ under the current directory).
